main_text.p: Colophonem huic adiicere, intercurrentes quidam strepitus musas meas interturbantes tunc non sinebant: Nunc vero non sine labo-re ad finem eam perduxi, luce etiam tandem donandam. Etsi autem hic locus postulat, ut eas artes & doctrinas, in quibus explicandis versor,ornem & prædicem, tamen cum de iis ab aliis, eloquentiâ excellentibus, splendidè & copiosè dictum sit, sumpsi aliud argumentum huic tempori conuenientissimum; quando-quidem ad nos redierūt dies bacchanaliorum, qui apud Ethnicos fuerunt hominum aut si-mulantium furores, aut ebrietate infanienti-um; qui ad portentosas atq; monstrificas hel-luationes ac conmessationes instistuuntur, sola simulatione insaniæ & repræsentatione gestus bacchantium: horum inquam recordatio, & memoriæ similiumq; monstrificarum baccha-tionum, quibus nostrum seculum se contami-nauit,celebratio, in hanc potissimum me sen-tentiam adduxit, ut de luxus in conuiuiis origi-ne & primis autoribus ex hoc loco ornatissimo quædam dicere non erubescerem: idq; eo fa-cio lubentius in hoc consessu, quoniam scio vos de eo seuerè & verissimè censuram ferre posse:nullæ hic sunt nugæ: nihil monstrosum, fabulosum nihil, neque item infulsæ traditio-nes, haustæ ex fæce quorundam tribulariorum scriptorum,sed ex autoribus Græcis pariter at-que

page.notes: The first word of the text is printed as "Colophonem" with a short line ending; the 'si' spacing in several words is irregular in the scan. "versor,ornem" and "similiumq;" are as printed. The word "strepitus" and "infulsæ" are as printed. Several letters in the middle of the page (e.g. "instistuuntur", "redierūt") are slightly blurred; readings follow the printed letters as best seen. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout; "vt" changed to "ut" per convention; other v/u forms kept as printed.
